results.title: A reading plan as the old reader shows it
results.checks: A plan of John 1–3 started Daily shows '3 days · started …', 'Next: Day 1 · John 1', and open, 'ends …', '~N min/day' and Day 1–3 tabs; Read plays Day 1 in the reader and at its end asks 'Nice reading! Mark Day 1 complete?' → Mark as complete ticks Day 1; Day 2's Mark complete waits for its reading, then says 'Day 2 complete!'; Delete asks 'Delete reading plan?'
results.note: summary, Read with the Nice reading prompt, Day 2 complete!, deleted after the check

results.title: Edit a reading plan
results.checks: Library → Reading plans → Start a blank plan; Save waits for a reading; type Romans 8:28-39 into day 1, add a day with Psalm 23 and the chapter on screen, a nonsense reference is refused; move day 2 up and name it; offer Weekly; Save — the card shows the days in the new order, kept after a reload, with Start · Weekly

results.title: A chapter's plans at its end; Nice reading!
results.checks: With a started plan of John 1–5, John 3 ends with a 'Reading Plans' card naming the plan and 'Mark John 3 as read'; reading on to the card (twelve seconds on the chapter) raises 'Nice reading! Mark John 3 complete?' — Mark as complete ticks the plan there
results.note: John 3 ended with the plan's card; after the read the nudge's Mark as complete ticked it
